name: Clark County, Indiana (United States)
description: White field bearing a dark blue map of the county overlaid with the torch and stars of the Indiana state flag and two early settlers in white, with CLARK COUNTY INDIANA in blue and green beside it.
history: Clark County is a county in Indiana, located directly across the Ohio River from Louisville, Kentucky.
